result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **I'd recommend Gusto as the best starting point**, especially if you want payroll, employee onboarding, benefits, and basic HR management in one system.

However, the best choice depends on whether you need basic HR administration or a more complete HR management platform.

Here are my top five recommendations for 2026.

## Best HR software for small companies

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

Starting at approximately \$49/month + \$6 per employee

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding and documentation
- Benefits administration
- PTO and time tracking options

Best for companies that want payroll and HR together.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR platform)

Pricing varies; small-team plans may start around \$250/month

- Employee records and organizational charts
- Recruiting and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO management
- Employee self-service

Best if you want a proper HR department system rather than just payroll.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

Starting around \$8/employee/month plus platform fee; modules extra

- HR and payroll
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Software and device management
- Automated workflows

Best for a growing company that wants to automate operations.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

Free tier available; paid plans start around \$1.50/user/month

- Employee database
- Attendance and time tracking
- Leave management
- Performance management
- Custom HR workflows

Best for smaller companies looking to keep software costs down.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. ADP RUN**

(Best for payroll support)

Custom pricing

- Payroll processing
- Tax administration
- HR support
- Employee management
- Compliance assistance

Best for owners who want an established payroll provider with additional HR services.

[ADP RUN website](https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/run-powered-by-adp.aspx)

Pricing is approximate and depends on employee count, plan, add-ons, and billing terms. ## My recommendation by company size

| Company size | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 1–10 employees | Gusto or Zoho People |
| 10–25 employees | Gusto or BambooHR |
| 25–50 employees | BambooHR or Rippling |
| 50–100 employees | Rippling or BambooHR |
